query: How do I reset my password?
reference_answer: Go to the login page, click 'Forgot password?', enter your email, and use the reset link sent to you, which is valid for 30 minutes.

query: I didn't get the password reset email, what should I do?
reference_answer: Check your spam folder since reset emails come from no-reply@example.com; if you no longer have access to that email, contact support with a government-issued ID to verify your identity.

query: How do I get a refund?
reference_answer: Open a support ticket with your order ID and reason; annual plans are refundable within 14 days, monthly plans within 7 days, and refunds are processed within 5-10 business days.

query: What happens if my card payment fails?
reference_answer: The payment is retried three times over five days, with an email notification before each retry, before the account is downgraded to the free tier.

query: What is the API rate limit?
reference_answer: The free tier allows 100 requests per minute per API key, and paid plans allow 1,000 requests per minute; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

query: If I create more API keys, will I get a higher rate limit?
reference_answer: No, rate limits are tracked per account rather than per key, so all keys on an account share the same quota.

query: How do I delete my account?
reference_answer: Go to Account > Settings > Delete Account, re-enter your password, and confirm; deletion has a 30-day grace period before data is permanently erased.

query: If I delete my account, will I get a refund for the current billing period?
reference_answer: Deleting the account cancels future billing but does not refund the current billing period unless it falls within the refund window.

query: How do I set up two-factor authentication?
reference_answer: Enable it under Account > Security using a TOTP authenticator app; SMS-based 2FA is not supported, and you'll get 10 single-use backup codes.

query: I lost my authenticator app and my backup codes, what do I do?
reference_answer: Account recovery requires manual identity verification through support, which can take up to 3 business days.
